Feel the wind in your hair and the spray of the sea as you navigate the waves, creating unforgettable moments with every turn. Whether you’re a seasoned rider or a first-time adventurer, our top-of-the-line jet skis promise a thrilling experience that will leave you craving more. quotes.author: Paul G
quotes.text: Even though we live in Palm Harbor we visit Flying High every Labor Day for the past 8 years...Great group of people working there in all aspects of the business...from the front to instructions to having a blast for an hour...to getting helped off at the end...This group of people are classy and always make the experience memorable...high recommend!

quotes.author: Jason Hammonds
quotes.text: Awesome jet ski experience. Professional staff. Talked with owner about issue that was totally my confusion and mistake, but what a terrific guy. Responded and was very kind and helpful. With that kind of ownership, deal with confidence. A+++++
